identification: Alison Cooper-White (Launceston/Evandale area Tasmanian artist), acrylic on burl slab, 'Thylacine', 60 x 57 cm, unsigned in photos. A modest living regional artist, not an established name.

entries.price: $150 AUD (Two Ravens on Huon Pine); $160 (Sheep on Huon); $120 (Sheep in Oval)
entries.note: Page opened. Artist's own asking prices for small paintings on recycled or Huon pine wood. Smaller than lot; no thylacine or burl listed. Shows her wood works ask $120-160 at retail; the lot is larger.
Via local comps database. Framed Gould/Richter thylacine print, not original art; shows thylacine premium for prints ($60-240). Hammer, premium extra.
Via local comps database. Bill Flowers signed oil on board, quoll vs thylacine, 7 bids. Closest original thylacine painting comp; a signed oil by a minor local artist.
Via local comps database. Paper mache thylacine by Tasmanian artist Lindsay Arnold, 2 bids. Weak demand for minor local decorative thylacine objects.

viewing_check: Read the handwritten card beside it and check the back and lower edge for a signature, date or title; confirm it is acrylic painted directly on the burl and the finish is intact. A confirmed Cooper-White signature adds little; main value is decorative.
